metadata.description: Reviewed runtime support overlay for the active hero formula seed set. These rows improve catalog, pricing, supplier, and dilution resolution without changing formula composition.
guardrails: Do not expand Botanical Musk or Driftwood accords from this overlay.
Do not infer ambiguous supplier-specific materials without user confirmation.
Diluted stock rows preserve formula display names while mapping active percentage to clear parent materials.
